event_time_basis: User confirmation observed in the current exchange; recorded_at_utc is the receipt creation time, not a fabricated message timestamp.
confirmed_scope_plaintext: 保留但隔离这些未经授权的 API 返回及依赖它们的判断，仅用原授权允许的普通浏览重新建立受影响的 P31 文献依据，再完成本轮剩余复核；不自动重启全轮，也不追认越界。

network_boundary.allowed: Only configured Codex web browsing for ordinary search and primary/authoritative human-readable pages. Minimal bibliographic queries and 8–12-word originality fragments only, no manuscript upload.
forbidden: All programmatic bibliographic API calls, regardless of language/client or whether invoked through a shell, HTTP library, subprocess, custom adapter, or a web API URL.
Crossref/OpenAlex/SemanticScholar/arXiv API endpoints; no repeated requests to any rate-limited API.
Programmatic network access for this audit, credential extraction, external models, claim-standing probes, access-control bypass.
Changing environmental settings to enable an excluded network path.
network_boundary.handling_of_unavailability: Preserve real access failure or unavailable metadata; do not bypass the boundary or invent support.

preservation.replacements: Use recovery1_* names for any artifact superseding an existing pre-pause item; never overwrite one.

resumed_ownership.root: P29 remaining full-audit outputs, P32 substantive C/E/compliance work and root integration/protection/final Schema5/12 checks.
resumed_ownership.r3_resume_p30: Finish P30 remaining E6 and final report artifacts; reuse valid unchanged own ordinary-browser and official local check results.
resumed_ownership.r3_resume_p31: Independently re-establish P31 affected source metadata via ordinary browsing only; recompute dependent judgments into new recovery1 files, finish P31 report. Do not use quarantined API outputs as controlling evidence.
resumed_ownership.r3_resume_p33: Finish P33 evidence-row/report work from current fixed inputs. Bounded P32 A/B/D work may be reassigned explicitly after P33 handoff; no automatic switch.

delegation_boundary: Workers may not invoke any network access except configured web browsing, may not overwrite any preserved file, and must disclose any incidental failure or input mismatch. Root will review evidence and output binding, not treat same-model agreement as independent scientific validation.
verification_reuse: Do not repeat successful official checks on unchanged valid inputs. Changed dependency or new final report may require new bound replay. P29 registry ref/anchor attribution changed after the old coverage build, so current coverage must be built/replayed against the changed current registry. P31 replacement semantic/verdict evidence requires fresh dependent output and replay; original bundle validation remains reusable.
stop_policy: A new actual protected-input mismatch, official validation failure, access/permission breach, or necessary authority expansion stops the affected execution. Preserve exact failure; no lock/receipt repair or automatic scope expansion.
